items.source: Select groups to configure through a Predicate.
items.translation: 选择组以通过 `Predicate` 进行配置。

items.source: Select groups to configure by name.
items.translation: 按名称选择要配置的组。

items.source:
Callback to customize the client builder for every group matched by
the specified name or predicate filters, or to all groups
if no filters are specified.
items.translation: 回调以针对由指定名称或谓词过滤器匹配的每个组自定义客户端构建器，或者如果未指定过滤器则针对所有组。

items.source:
Callback to supply the client builder for every group matched by
the specified name or predicate filters, or to all groups
if no filters are specified.
items.translation: 回调以向每个由指定名称或谓词过滤器匹配到的组提供客户端构建器，或者如果未指定过滤器则向所有组提供。

items.source:
Callback to customize the client builder and the proxy factory for
every group matched by the specified name or predicate filters,
or to all groups if no filters are specified.
items.translation: 回调以自定义由指定名称或谓词过滤器匹配的每个组的客户端构建器和代理工厂，或者如果未指定过滤器则为所有组。

items.source:
Callback to customize the proxy factory for every group matched by
the specified name or predicate filters, or to all groups
if no filters are specified.
items.translation: 回调以自定义由指定名称或谓词过滤器匹配的每个组（或如果未指定过滤器则为所有组）的代理工厂。

items.source: Contract to help iterate and configure the set of groups.
items.translation: 合同用于帮助迭代和配置组集。

items.source: CB - the type of client builder, i.e. RestClient or WebClient builder.
items.translation: CB - 客户端构建器的类型，即 RestClient 或 WebClient 构建器。
